subject: Marine Works - Pipeline - Fraser River
text:
Marine Works - Pipeline - Fraser River
Pipeline operations in the vicinity of Road No.5 at 49 07.230N 123 05.161W. 
The pipelines and other equipment will be anchored and equipment will be installed with flashing lights.

Hours of operation daily from 1300UTC Oct 22 to 0100UTC Nov 14. 
Vessels on site monitoring VHF Ch. 74. requesting contact upon approach.
